s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic multisystem disease with autoimmune features, characterized by skin, joint, and lung involvement, with a prolonged course of symptoms and significant weight loss
salient_findings: Symmetric swelling of metacarpophalangeal and interphalangeal joints with ulcers
Dyspigmentation and atrophy of distal fingers
Bibasilar rales on auscultation
Elevated ferritin levels
Lymphocytopenia with positive anti-SSA (Ro) antibodies
Restrictive lung disease with decreased diffusing capacity
key_facts: 7-month history of fatigue, exertional dyspnea, arthralgias, hand swelling, tender ulcerations, hair loss, and weight loss
Previous hospitalization for hypoxia
Prior treatment with prednisone
Symmetric joint swelling preventing fist formation
Normal capillaroscopy
Ulcerated lichenoid papules on palmar IP creases
Oxford Scale muscle strength 5 of 5 throughout
Elevated ferritin levels (1543 ng/mL)
Lymphocytopenia with CD3: 328 μL, CD4: 233 μL, CD8: 85 μL
Positive anti-SSA (Ro) antibodies
Positive immunoglobulin G anticardiolipin antibodies (19.5 units)
Normal prothrombin time, partial thromboplastin time, tissue thromboplastin
Chest CT showing hilar lymphadenopathy, interstitial thickening, and perilymphatic ground glass opacities
Pulmonary function tests showing restrictive disease with decreased diffusing capacity (33% predicted)
Skin biopsy showing orthokeratosis, minimal basal vacuolar change, pigment incontinence, and diffuse vasculopathy with fibrin thrombi

shortlist.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
shortlist.why_kept: Positive anti-SSA (Ro) antibodies, lymphocytopenia, and multisystem involvement

shortlist.label: Mixed Connective Tissue Disease
shortlist.why_kept: Overlapping features of lupus, rheumatoid arthritis, and scleroderma, with positive anti-SSA (Ro) antibodies and interstitial lung disease

shortlist.label: Sjögren's Syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Positive anti-SSA (Ro) antibodies and interstitial lung disease, with potential for extraglandular manifestations

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin involvement with ulcerated lichenoid papules, and potential for muscle weakness, although muscle strength is currently normal

shortlist.label: Scleroderma
shortlist.why_kept: Skin thickening and interstitial lung disease, although some features such as esophageal involvement are not mentioned
